sections.label: Our Services
text: Our Services
Every child is different, so every plan is too. We offer assessment and therapy services tailored to the individual, delivered wherever they'll have the most impact.
OT Assessments
Comprehensive assessments covering sensory processing, motor skills, self-care and daily living skills, resulting in a clear, actionable report.
Sensory Integration Therapy
Structured, play-based therapy to help children process and respond to sensory information, reducing overwhelm and building regulation skills.
Fine Motor & Handwriting
Individual and small-group programmes to build pencil control, hand strength and handwriting fluency at a pace that suits the child.
Gross Motor & Coordination
Support for balance, coordination and movement planning, helping children take part confidently in PE, playtime and everyday activity.
Independence & Self-Care
Practical support with dressing, feeding, toileting and other daily routines, building the skills and confidence for greater independence.
Parent & Carer Coaching
Guidance and strategies for the adults around the child, so therapy goals translate into calmer, more manageable daily routines at home.

sections.label: How We Work
text: How We Work
A straightforward, transparent process from first contact through to ongoing support.
Referral & Enquiry
Get in touch by form, phone or email. We'll ask a few questions to understand what support is needed.
Assessment
A qualified occupational therapist carries out a thorough assessment at home, school or clinic.
Report & Recommendations
You receive a clear written report with findings and practical, achievable recommendations.
Therapy & Review
Where ongoing therapy is needed, we agree goals together and review progress regularly.

sections.label: Who We Work With
text: Who We Work With
Occupational therapy works best as a team effort. We build strong working relationships with everyone around the child.
Children & Young People
From early years through to young adulthood, we tailor every session to the individual's age, interests and goals.
Families
We support parents and carers with honest guidance, useful strategies and someone to turn to along the way.
Schools
We collaborate with SENCOs and teaching staff to embed strategies into the classroom and daily school life.

sections.label: About Sensphere
text: About Sensphere

Sensphere was founded to make high-quality occupational therapy more accessible to children, young people and the families and schools who support them. We believe therapy should fit around a child's real life, not the other way round.

Our team consists of experienced, HCPC-registered occupational therapists with specialist training in paediatric practice, sensory integration and working within the SEND framework. sections.label: Working With Schools
text: Working With Schools

We know how stretched school teams can be, so we aim to make working with us as easy as possible. We provide assessments, staff training and ongoing consultation to help you support pupils with sensory and motor needs day to day.
Whole-class and individual pupil assessments
Staff training on sensory processing and regulation
Input for EHCP applications and reviews
Sensory circuits and classroom strategy planning
Book a School Consultation
Speak with us about how occupational therapy support could work for your setting, whether for one pupil or across a whole class.

text: Frequently Asked Questions
A few of the questions we're asked most often. Get in touch if you'd like to know more.

We offer flexibility around home, school and clinic settings, as well as online consultations where appropriate. We'll agree the best setting with you when we discuss the referral.
Yes. Our assessment reports are written to a standard suitable for supporting EHC needs assessments and annual reviews, and we're happy to liaise with the local authority or school where needed.
A typical assessment session lasts around 60-90 minutes, followed by a written report within two to three weeks. Timescales may vary depending on the complexity of the referral.
